chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin Judah mite’ pawikhamna a tun’ lai takin, Zeisu Jerusalem khua-ah a paito hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah Tuu Kongkhak tawh kinai, Hebru pau-in Bethzatha kici bual khat a om hi. Tua bual kimkot ah buk nga a om hi.
Tuate ah mittaw, khezaw, pum langkhat si akipan cina tampite a lum uh hi.
(Topa’ vantungmi khat ahun hunin hong paisuk zel a, tui a kiloksak hi. Tui a kilawh hun sungin tua bualtui sung a tung masapen pen, a natna peuhpeuh a damsiang pahpah hi).
Kum sawmthum leh kum giat tawntung a kumzawn mi khat in tuasan takah a om hi.
Tua pa luma om Zeisu in a mu hi. Sawt veipi cina-a om cih a theih ciangin, “Nang cidam na ut hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Cinapa in, “Topa aw, tui a tat ciangin bual sungah hong koih ding mi ka nei kei hi. Kei ka pai lai takin midangte ka mai-ah a tum uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Zeisu in, “Tho in, na lupna pua in la, pai in,” a cih ciangin,
thakhatin tuapa dam a, a lupna pua-in lam a pai hi. Tua ni in Sabbath ni ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in a kiangah, “Tuni in Sabbath ni ahi hi; lupna puak tuak lo hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Amah in, “Kei hong damsakpa in, ‘Na lupna pua in la, lam pai in,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Judah mite in, “Na lupna pua in la, lam pai in,” hong ci kua ahi hiam? ci-in a dong uh hi.
Ahih hangin cidamna a ngahpa in kua ahi hiam a thei kei hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua munah mihonpi om ahih ciangin Zeisu a paikhia sim hi.
Tua nung ciangin Zeisu in biakna innpi sungah tua pa a muh ciangin, “Nang na ci dam zo hi. Tua gimna sangin a haksa zaw na thuak loh nadingin, a nung ciangin mawhna na hih nawn kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua pa paikhia a, amah a damsakpa in Zeisu hi, ci-in Judah mite kiangah a gen hi.
Tua thu Sabbath ni-in bawl ahih ciangin, Judah mite in Zeisu bawlsia-in thah theih nading thu a zong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka Pa in tudongin a sem hi; ke’n zong ka sem hi,” ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Sabbath ni siasak tham loin, Pasian nangawn “Ka Pa hi” ci-in Pasian bangin kibawl hi ci-in, Judah mite in Zeisu a that nuam semsem zaw uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Tapa in ama deih bangin a hih thei kei hi. Pa’ hihna a muh bangin a bawl thei hi. Pa in a bawl mah bangin Ta in zong a bawl hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pa in Ta it a, a hihna khempeuh Tapa a musak hi. Note in lamdang nasak nadingun hih sangin a lianzaw nate Tapa a musak ding hi.
Pa in mi sisate a thosak, a hingsak kik mah bangin Tapa in zong ama deihte a hingsak thei hi.
Mi khempeuh in Pa a zahtak bangin Tapa zong a zahtak nadingin, Pa in kuamah thu a khen kei hi.
Thukhen nading thu khempeuh Tapa a pia hi. Tapa a zahtak lo mi in Tapa a sawlpa zong a zahtak kei hi.”
“Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, keima thu za a, keimah hong sawlpa a um mi in, nuntak tawntungna ngah zo ahih ciangin, thukhenna a thuak kei hi; sihna pan paikhia a, nuntakna-ah a tung zo hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, a sisate in Pasian’ Tapa’ aw a zak nading uh a hun hong tung ding tham loin tu-in zong a tung zo hi. Tua aw a zate in a nungta ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pa in a sungah nuntakna a neih bangin, Tapa in zong a sungah nuntakna a neih nadingin thu a pia zo hi.
Tapa in Mihing Tapa ahih maninah thukhen dingin Pa in thu a pia hi.
Hih thu lamdang na sa kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, han sungah a omte khempeuh in ama aw za uh a, a hong pusuak hun hong tung ding hi.
A pha-a gamtate in nuntakna ngah dingin hong thokik ding uh a; a sia-a gamtate in thukhenna thuak dingin hong thokik ding uh hi.”

“Keimah in ka ut bangin ka hih thei kei hi. Ka zak bangin thu ka khen hi. Ka thukhenna in thu taktak ahi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima deihna bang hi loin, kei hong sawlpa’ deihna bangin ka hih hi.
Keima ading teci ka pan’ leh, ka teci pan’na thu a man kei hi.
Kei ading teci pang ding mi khat a om hi. Kei adinga ama teci pan’na thu in aman hi ci-in ka thei hi.
Note in Johan kiangah na sawl zo uh hi. Amah in thuman thutak teci a pang zo hi.
Ahih hangin ka teci pan’na thu in mite’ teci pan’na ahi kei hi. Note in gupna na ngah nadingun hih thu teng kong gen hi.
Amah in kuanga a taang meivak hi a, note in ama khuavakna-ah tawlkhat nopsak ding bek na ut uh hi.

Ahih hangin Johan’ teci pan’na sangin teci pan’na a lianzaw ka nei hi. Bang ahi hiam na cih uh leh, nasepna ka zawh nading ka Pa in hong piak tu-a ka sepna thute in, Pa in kei hong sawl ahihna thu keima ading teci hong pang uh hi.
Kei hong sawl ka Pa in kei ading teci hong pang zo hi. Note in tua Pa’ aw na za kei uh a, a meel na mu ngei kei uh hi.
Ama thu in zong nomau sungah a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a hong sawlpa no na um kei uh hi.
Lai Siangtho hangah nuntak tawntungna ngah nung ci-in na up manunah Lai Siangtho na tel et uh hi. Hih Lai Siangtho in keima ading teci ahi hi.
Note in nuntakna na ngah nadingun ka kiangah nong pai kei uh hi.
Mite piak minthan’na ka sang kei hi.
Ahih hangin, Pasian itna lungsim na neih loh uh ke’n ka thei hi.
Kei in ka Pa’ min tawh kong pai hangin nong sang kei uh hi. Midang khatpeuh amahmah min tawh hong pai leh, na sang ding uh hi.
Khat leh khat kipiak minthan’na na ngah uh a, Pasian khat bek’ piak theih minthan’na a zong lo note in bangci up theih ding na hi uh hiam?
Pa mai-ah hong mawhsak ding hi ci-in hong um kei un. Note hong mawhsak ding mi khat a om lai hi. Tua pa in kua mi ahi hiam ci-in na dot uh leh, na muanpa uh Moses ahi hi.
Note in Moses’ thu na up uh leh, keima thu zong nong um ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Moses in keima thu a gelh hi.
Ama gelhna lai na up kei uh leh, keima thu bangci up thei ding na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a gen hi.
